summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing the minutes of its Annual General Meeting held on April 29, 2026. The meeting was conducted entirely digitally and covered routine matters: review of management report, financial statements for fiscal year 2025, independent auditor's opinion (KPMG), and fiscal council opinion. Attendance was high at 98.67% of common shares and 77.76% of preferred shares. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring—was announced. This is a routine foreign private issuer report of an ordinary shareholder meeting, not a special situation filing.
